E0106

Redefining a built-in

What

Redefining a built-in

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Rename the declaration so it does not shadow a built-in.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0106: tests/ui/marker_trait_collision.stderr.

Error [E0106]: The name `Layout` is a non-derive type marker
  --> tests/ui/marker_trait_collision.jet:1:7
    |
  1 | trait Layout {
    |       ^^^^^^
 Why: Trait names become their matching `#Trait` derive spelling, while this marker has different semantics
 Fix: Choose a trait name that does not collide with a registered type marker
